description: Works the way SmartFin's withdrawal calculator does, with withdrawals monthly, quarterly or annually and the balance earning a yearly return between them. how_long: how many years a balance lasts at a set withdrawal, optionally rising each year with inflation. how_much: the withdrawal that lasts a given number of years, or that never touches the principal (lasts_forever). Use for "how long will my savings last" or "how much can I withdraw". Do not use to find a savings target (use smartfin_calculate_fire_number). Returns are an assumption; excludes taxes and fees.

frequency.description: How often money is withdrawn. Default monthly

inflation_pct.description: For how_long, optional: the withdrawal rises by this % each year

lasts_forever.description: For how_much: the withdrawal that never touches the principal

question.description: how_long needs withdrawal_amount; how_much needs years or lasts_forever

withdrawal_amount.description: For how_long: each withdrawal, in dollars, at the chosen frequency

years.description: For how_much: how many years the money should last

name: smartfin_calculate_retirement_withdrawal

how_to.description: Steps for the user to see or redo this on smartfin.fyi

embed.description: Free embed code for this calculator, for a site the user runs

page.description: SmartFin's page for this stock, when it has one

smartfin.description: Open and adjust this result on smartfin.fyi

summary.description: Plain-language result the assistant can quote

title: Retirement withdrawals: how long or how much
